title: 第22章 心腹再次算计
novel_title: 绑定全国，每人每天给我一两银
content_zh:
营地，流民聚集地。

    刘傲潇洒离去，气氛却依旧沉闷。

    那些流民缩在一起，有些不敢去看陆舟。

    尤其是那位被救的女人，更是神情惶恐，瑟瑟发抖。

    只因他们虽知道这位王爷爱民如子，却依旧不敢站在他的身后。

    陆舟扫了一眼，面色如常，并不在意。

    成大事者，不拘小节！

    若因这点小事动摇内心，那今后还如何掌控云州？

    他收回目光，看向身旁的李雄。

    对方捂着胸口，面部微颤，强忍着痛意。

    身为六品顶级武者的刘傲，摆明是来立威的，出手极为狠辣。

    饶是李雄身为六品初阶武者，依旧受了很重的内伤。

    只是这个一米八的汉子咬着牙，什么都没说。

    陆舟当即从怀中掏出一个玉瓶，倒出一枚翠绿色的丹药。

    丹纹如竖弦，清气缭绕。

    他递给了李雄：“吃了它。”

    李雄忍着痛，看到那丹药上的竖纹，心头微震，连忙道：“王爷，这丹药太贵重了……属下受之有愧！”

    这枚绿色气血丹的品质已达六品，且还是专门用于疗伤的，对于他而言，有着巨大帮助。

    但他却不敢收下。

    “这是命令！”陆舟沉声道，不想与之废话。

    现阶段，周川和李雄是自己最重要的帮手，他不希望对方留下隐患，影响武道根基。

    李雄嘴唇翕动，眼眶竟有些泛红。

    能得王爷如此看重，他内心无比感动。

    但即便如此，李雄依旧不敢去接。

    他这人心思单纯，觉得自己受了王爷这么多好处，如今却连一个刘傲都拦不住，还让王爷当众出丑，哪有脸再拿这般珍贵的赏赐？

    “拿着吧，都是王爷的心思。”

    身后，周川上前替李雄接下了那枚绿色丹药，又在其耳边低声道：“你若因此武道受损，今后如何保护王爷？”

    李雄身体一震，眼睛猛地睁大了。

    是啊……他怎么没想到这一层？

    他当即用力点头，将丹药一口吞入腹中……

    药效散开，随即一股温热之气从小腹升起，缓缓梳理着体内郁结的气血。
content_en:
Camp, a gathering place for refugees.

    Liu Ao left gracefully, but the atmosphere was still dull.

    The refugees huddled together, and some did not dare to look at Lu Zhou.

    Especially the woman who was rescued looked terrified and trembling.

    Just because although they knew that this prince loved his people like his own son, they still did not dare to stand behind him.

    Lu Zhou glanced at it, his expression was as usual and he didn't care.

    Those who achieve great things do not stick to trivial matters!

    If your heart is shaken by this little thing, how can you control Yunzhou in the future?

    He withdrew his gaze and looked at Li Xiong beside him.

    The other person held his chest, his face trembled slightly, and he was holding back the pain.

    Liu Ao, a top-level sixth-grade warrior, clearly wanted to establish his authority, and his attacks were extremely ruthless.

    Even though Li Xiong was a sixth-grade junior warrior, he still suffered serious internal injuries.

    But this 1.8 meter man gritted his teeth and said nothing.

    Lu Zhou immediately took out a jade bottle from his arms and poured out an emerald green pill.

    The elixir pattern is like a vertical string, and the fresh air is lingering.

    He handed it to Li Xiong: "Eat it."

    Li Xiong endured the pain, and when he saw the vertical lines on the elixir, his heart was slightly shaken, and he quickly said: "Your Majesty, this elixir is too precious... I deserve it!"

    The quality of this green Qi and Blood Pill has reached the sixth level, and it is specially used for healing wounds. It is of great help to him.

    But he didn't dare accept it.

    "This is an order!" Lu Zhou said solemnly, not wanting to talk nonsense.

    At this stage, Zhou Chuan and Li Xiong are his most important helpers. He does not want the other party to leave hidden dangers and affect the foundation of martial arts.

    Li Xiong's lips moved and his eyes turned red.

    He was extremely touched to have the prince value him so much.

    But even so, Li Xiong still didn't dare to pick it up.

    He was a simple-minded person who felt that he had received so many benefits from the prince, but now he couldn't even stop Liu Ao and even made the prince make a fool of himself in public. How could he have the nerve to take such a precious reward again?

    "Take it, it's all the prince's wish."

    Behind him, Zhou Chuan stepped forward to take the green elixir for Li Xiong, and whispered in his ear: "If your martial arts is damaged because of this, how will you protect the prince in the future?"

    Li Xiong's body trembled and his eyes suddenly opened wide.

    Yes...why didn't he think of this level?

    He immediately nodded vigorously and swallowed the elixir in one gulp...

    The effect of the medicine dissipated, and then a warm air rose from the lower abdomen, slowly sorting out the stagnation of qi and blood in the body.
